row:
Part travel documentary, part animal health show, Dr. Cliff, Worldwide Vet merges two very successful genres to grant viewers entertainment and knowledge. Follow Dr. Cliff Redford as he travels to exotic locations around the world and works with local animal rescues in caring for injured and sick pets. In between cases one can learn about exotic locations and wildlife, witness beautiful traditions and cultures, and be entertained by the adventures that ensue. Be prepared to laugh and cry as you come to the realization that as different as people may be, deep down inside we all share the same fascination and love for the creatures we share the world with.

So be sure to subscribe and share this amazing new show with your friends.
